newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.889 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement rises to 4.889 mln gallons.

text.p: Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended June 7 was 4,889,350 gallons compared with 4,833,513 gallons last week.
Imports were 92,565 gallons compared with 334,582 gallons the previous week. There were 744 domestic receipts for this week compared with 125,805 the previous week.
Retail movement was 760,794 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,650,005 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 142,535,997 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 4,412,824 gallons.
